mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen in each of the last three weekly means (-39.6, -27.6, -22.6, -21.3). This monotone recovery momentum persists: the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the -27.775 mean of the last 28 days.

failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is at or below -27.775, the mean of the last 28 days.
